newsitem.title: USA: Vanguard cuts air fares for children, seniors.
newsitem.headline: Vanguard cuts air fares for children, seniors.

text.p: Vanguard Airlines Inc on Monday said it would offer 10 percent discounts to senior citizens and children for tickets purchased February 17 and afterwards.

To introduce the new fares, the airline said it was offering 25 percent discounts to passengers over 65 years old, while children under 12 will receive 50 percent discounts on tickets purchased by February 16 for travel completed by July 11.
Vanguard also said it would allow tickets to be purchased only three days in advance for all its fares between now and February 16.
